cableTray.name: Cable Tray Penetration
cableTray.description: The opening where cables pass through floors and walls. Left unsealed, it lets fire and smoke spread from one compartment to another.

metalPipe.name: Metal Pipe Penetration
metalPipe.description: The point where metal pipework passes through structural elements. Its thermal conductivity calls for extra attention.

pvcPipe.name: PVC Pipe Penetration
pvcPipe.description: The penetration point for PVC pipework. It can melt under high heat and create an opening, which calls for a dedicated seal.

hvacDuct.name: HVAC Duct Penetration
hvacDuct.description: The penetration point for HVAC ductwork. It must be protected to stop fire and smoke spreading through the air ducts.

floorWallJoint.name: Floor-Wall Joint
floorWallJoint.description: The structural joint line where floor meets wall. This gap can open under building movement and must be fire-sealed.

curtainWall.name: Curtain Wall Penetration
curtainWall.description: The gap between the curtain wall system and the floor slab. A critical point for stopping fire spread between floors.

structuralJoint.name: Structural Joint
structuralJoint.description: The joint line that allows for the building's structural movement. It needs a flexible fire seal that keeps its integrity through expansion and contraction.

landscape.name: Landscape Design
landscape.description: Functional and aesthetic yard layout around the building — green spaces, walking paths, and open-area planning.

exteriorDesign.name: Facade & Exterior Design
exteriorDesign.description: Modern cladding systems, facade materials, and architectural solutions for the building's exterior appearance.

delaySpread.title: Stops Fire Spread
delaySpread.description: Prevents flames from spreading to other areas.

reduceSmoke.title: Blocks Smoke
reduceSmoke.description: Effectively reduces the passage of smoke and toxic gases.

evacuationTime.title: Buys Time
evacuationTime.description: Creates extra time for evacuation, protecting human life.

protectStructure.title: Protects the Structure
protectStructure.description: Protects the building's structure and minimizes material damage.
